name: ivory-editorial
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity design proposal for Artifex, a native macOS workspace and Markdown/code reader. Input image 1 is the CURRENT APP screenshot, structural reference only. Show a straight-on full app window, landscape 16:10, crisp readable typography, no device, no perspective, no marketing framing. Preserve the current four-column structure: narrow workspace rail, Files tree sidebar, large Markdown document center, narrow ON THIS PAGE outline with LINKED FILES below. Keep search in top toolbar, breadcrumbs and document tabs, Preview/Raw toggle, subtle bottom git/status strip. Preserve Files, Search, Changes navigation and multiple workspace rows. Use artifex as selected workspace and DESIGN.md as selected document, other tabs zsh and README.md. Use demo English content in document: "Design principles", intro "A quiet workspace for focused work.", sections "Clarity over chrome", "A place for every detail", and relevant short paragraphs. File tree docs, fixtures, scripts, src, Cargo.toml, DESIGN.md, README.md. No new features, AI/chat, dashboards, charts, illustrations or ornamental content. Design should be practical, premium, restrained, with excellent hierarchy and ample center content width.
Direction 1: IVORY EDITORIAL. Light warm monochrome across ALL columns including workspace rail and toolbar; ivory #F6F3ED, sidebar #EDE9E1, center warm white #FFFDFA, ink #242321, very restrained burnt-sienna #A44F32 selection accents. Distinctive elegant serif document headings only, sans serif UI and body. Calm book-like center with intentional reading measure and generous section spacing. Replace harsh borders with tonal separation and a few faint hairlines. Tight organized chrome, crisp thin icons, low-key count badges, selected document row soft terracotta tint. No shadows between panels, no gradients, no decorative textures. Premium editorial reading instrument.
